Steamatic is Australia’s longest established and largest restoration Company with over 35 locations throughout Australia and growing each year. We have available work Nationwide in Metropolitan and Regional areas.

We are now looking to recruit an experienced and qualified IT Support Technician to join our dedicated service team working in various locations throughout Australia.

The Role
We are looking for technically skilled candidate with good problem-solving ability for the position of IT Support Technician. The duties include being a reference point for all IT related queries at the user level, responding to user needs in a timely manner and ensuring the optimal running of all systems, among other technical duties.

The role includes but is not limited to the following duties:
Installing and configuring hardware and software components to ensure usability
Diagnosing, troubleshooting, and resolving connectivity, hardware, and software issues
Performing tests and evaluations of new software and hardware
Scheduling and conducting quality audit inspections, and analysing and reviewing systems, data and documentation
Identifying variations and potential high-risk areas in securing adherence to standards and procedures
Recommending corrective action plans and improvements in the resolution of non- compliance with standards detected through monitoring and auditing of processes and procedures
Communicating, educating, and liaising with users and management to ensure awareness and adherence to standards, procedures and quality control issues and activities
Assisting in troubleshooting, diagnosing, testing and resolving system problems and issues
Developing, conducting, and offering technical guidance and training in application software and operational procedures
Analysing, evaluating, and diagnosing technical problems and issues such as installation, maintenance, repair, upgrade and configuration and troubleshooting of desktops, software, hardware, printers, Internet, email, databases, operating systems and security systems
Testing, identifying and diagnosing functionality errors and faults in systems, and programming code within established testing protocols, guidelines and quality standards to ensure systems perform to specification
Performing organisational systems architecture reviews and assessments, and recommending current and future hardware and software strategies and directions
Creating and reviewing technical documentation such as procedural, instructional and operational guides and manuals, technical reports and specifications and maintenance inventory systems
Using project management methodologies, principles, and techniques to develop project plans and to cost, resource and manage projects
Test plans, which ensure acceptable quality and integrity of the system
Creating user and training documentation, and conducting formal training classes
Establishing good relationships with all departments and colleagues
Working with users to formulate and document business requirement
Investigating, and analysing business processes, procedures and work practices

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Previous work experience in the same field
3+ years of experience in computer networks and systems maintenance
Proficiency in computer systems, software installation, database programming, and cybersecurity basics
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Good interpersonal skills
Strong problem-solving, and time management skills
Attention to detail
Self-motivated and eager to learn and grow within the organisation

If you have the skills required for this role and you feel this is the job for you, then apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

As a Sheet Metal Worker, you'll play a key role in the fabrication, assembly and repair of precision sheet metal components used across a variety of manufacturing, engineering and industrial projects.
Working in modern, well-equipped workshops, you'll be part of a professional team delivering quality workmanship while maintaining the highest safety standards.

Your responsibilities will include:
• Fabricating and assembling sheet metal components to specification 
• Reading and interpreting engineering drawings, technical plans and fabrication details 
• Cutting, folding, bending, rolling and shaping sheet metal 
• MIG and TIG welding where required 
• Operating fabrication equipment including press brakes, guillotines, rollers, punches and other workshop machinery 
• Measuring, marking and preparing materials for fabrication 
• Repairing, modifying and installing fabricated components 
• Conducting quality inspections to ensure finished products meet engineering specifications Maintaining workshop equipment and ensuring a clean, organised work environment 
• Working safely in accordance with all workplace health and safety procedures 

About You
To be successful in this role, you'll have:
• Trade qualification as a Sheet Metal Worker, Metal Fabricator or equivalent recognised trade qualification
• Previous experience in sheet metal fabrication 
• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and fabrication plans 
• Experience operating fabrication machinery and workshop equipment 
• Strong fabrication, measuring and welding skills 
• High attention to detail with pride in producing quality workmanship 
• Ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team environment 
• Excellent communication and problem-solving skills 
• Strong commitment to workplace safety and quality standards 

Highly Regarded
While not essential, the following experience will be highly regarded:
• MIG and TIG welding experience 
• Stainless steel and aluminium fabrication experience 
• Experience working in manufacturing, mining or heavy industrial environments 
• Forklift Licence 
• Overhead Crane experience 
• Current Australian Driver's Licence 
• Experience with precision fabrication and custom metalwork 

Employer Sponsorship Available

MYAC Resources has extensive experience connecting skilled tradespeople with genuine long-term employment opportunities across Australia for suitably qualified candidates, employer sponsorship is available, subject to employer approval and Australian migration requirements.
Whether you're already in Australia or planning to relocate, we can help connect you with employers seeking skilled Sheet Metal Workers.

What's on Offer
• Permanent full-time position 
• Perth, Western Australia location 
• Competitive salary package with overtime opportunities 
• Long-term career stability with established Australian employers 
• Modern workshop facilities and quality equipment 
• Ongoing training and career development 
• Supportive, safety-focused team environment 
• Employer sponsorship available for eligible candidates 
• Opportunity to build a long-term career in Australia

MYAC Resources specialises in connecting skilled tradespeople with leading employers across Australia's manufacturing, engineering, mining and industrial sectors. We don't just recruit people—we help build long-term careers. From your initial application through to placement and ongoing support, our experienced recruitment team is committed to helping you succeed. If you're a skilled tradesperson who takes pride in quality workmanship and wants to work with reputable Australian employers, this is an opportunity you won't want to miss.

result.description:
Lead reliability at one of Australia's largest food manufacturing facilities!

At JBS Dinmore, the largest and most respected beef processing plants in the southern hemisphere, we are seeking an experienced Maintenance Superintendent to join our Maintenance Leadership Team.

Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing all maintenance activities within the abattoir, ensuring equipment reliability, compliance with WHS standards, and minimal downtime. This role manages maintenance teams, coordinates preventive and corrective maintenance, and supports continuous improvement initiatives to optimise plant performance This is a full-time role with annual salary higher than $120,000 plus Superannuation.

Key Responsibilities

· Plan, schedule, and supervise preventive and corrective maintenance activities.

· Ensure compliance with WHS, environmental, and food safety standards during maintenance operations.

· Manage maintenance team performance, rosters, and resource allocation.

· Monitor equipment reliability and implement strategies to reduce downtime.

· Coordinate with Production, QA, and Engineering to resolve technical issues promptly.

· Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, spare parts usage, and equipment history.

· Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance maintenance efficiency and cost-effectiveness.

· Ensure compliance with statutory inspections and regulatory requirements.

· Support capital projects and installation of new equipment.

· Encourage open communication so staff feel comfortable reporting hazards, equipment issues, or training needs.

· Reinforce teamwork between maintenance, operations, and QA, helping everyone understand the impact of their role on plant performance and food safety.

· Serve as a trusted point of contact for technical questions, offering approachable and supportive guidance.

· Additional tasks as requested by your supervisor or management.

About You

· Extensive experience in industrial maintenance within food processing or manufacturing.

· Strong knowledge of mechanical, electrical, and refrigeration systems.

· Understanding of WHS, environmental, and food safety compliance.

· Leadership and team management skills.

· Ability to analyse data and implement reliability improvement strategies.

· Trade qualification or engineering degree.

· Experience with CMMS (Computerised Maintenance Management Systems).

· Knowledge of Lean or continuous improvement methodologies.

Why Join JBS?

Leadership opportunity within Australia's largest food manufacturer
Influence reliability and maintenance strategy across a major production facility
Work with large-scale industrial equipment and modern automation systems
Ongoing professional development and career progression opportunities
Supportive leadership team and stable, long-term employment
If you're an experienced electrical leader ready to make a significant impact in a complex manufacturing environment, we'd love to hear from you.

The Ad is valid for 28 days.

Apply now and help drive operational excellence at JBS Dinmore.

result.description:
Your new company     
 Are you passionate about turning workforce data into meaningful insights that influence organisational strategy? We're seeking an experienced Senior Workforce Analyst to join a high-performing team responsible for shaping workforce decisions through analytics, reporting, and evidence-based insights. 
   
 This is an exciting opportunity to work at the intersection of people, data, and strategy, helping leaders understand workforce trends, identify future challenges, and make informed decisions that strengthen organisational capability. 
   Your new role     Your responsibilities will include: 
 
 Interpreting workforce data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities that support strategic people initiatives. 
 Developing reports, dashboards, and visualisations that provide meaningful workforce insights to leaders and decision-makers. 
 Partnering with stakeholders to understand business challenges and translate information needs into practical reporting solutions. 
 Supporting workforce planning and organisational change initiatives through accurate workforce and establishment analysis. 
 Maintaining the quality, accuracy, and integrity of workforce information through ongoing review and data governance activities. 
 Contributing to the evolution of workforce analytics through the development of new metrics, insights, and reporting approaches. 
 Sharing knowledge and supporting colleagues to continuously improve systems, processes, and service delivery outcomes. 
 
   What you'll need to succeed     
 You'll be a data-driven professional with the ability to balance technical capability with strong stakeholder engagement skills.   You enjoy solving complex problems, can confidently interpret large datasets, and are able to communicate findings in a way that influences decision-making. 
   
 You'll ideally bring: 
 
 Experience working with workforce, HR, payroll, or organisational data in a large and complex environment. 
 Advanced skills in Power BI, SQL, Excel, and other reporting or analytics platforms. 
 Experience developing dashboards, reports, and analytical products for diverse stakeholders. 
 Strong analytical thinking and the ability to translate complex information into clear recommendations. 
 Excellent relationship-building and communication skills. 
 Exposure to government workforce reporting or public sector environments will be highly regarded. 
 
   What you'll get in return     This role offers the opportunity to influence workforce strategy at an organisational level while working with modern analytics tools and methodologies. You'll join a collaborative team focused on continuous improvement, innovation, and delivering data-driven workforce solutions that make a real impact.      What you need to do now     If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.    If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion on your career.    Please  click here  to apply.
